$comment: SB-189: the one sentence a person reads for each backend refusal, on every surface (the window, the CLI, the MCP server). Keys are the backend's own text, which stays its internal vocabulary; switchboard_runtime::person_errors reads this file and src/adapter.ts imports it. scripts/check-error-vocabulary.mjs keeps every backend sentence here or in an allowlist.
